reason: The paper experimentally studies adversarial vulnerabilities of cost-efficient cascaded LLM deployments and measures token costs under attacks/defenses. Its focus is robustness/security rather than reducing inference cost, but the cascade architecture and explicit cost analysis leave a plausible weak connection to LLM routing/serving lineages.
title: When Efficiency Backfires: Cascading LLMs Trigger Cascade Failure under Adversarial Attack
